name: plugin.brain_bridge
description: Mounts, inspects, and federates external agent brains, Git/GitHub repositories, IDE transcripts, and knowledge libraries
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: brain_attach
entrypoints.description: Inspect and mount an external brain, Git repository (local path or remote URL), IDE state, or knowledge directory

parameters.name: folder_path
parameters.description: Absolute/relative path to a directory or remote Git URL (e.g. 'https://github.com/org/repo')

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: Short mnemonic name for this mounted brain/repo (e.g. 'upstream_harness', 'fastapi_core')

parameters.name: read_transcripts
parameters.description: Whether to parse and index conversation transcripts and trajectory logs (default: true)

parameters.name: read_commits
parameters.description: Whether to parse and index Git commit history into cognitive trajectory chunks (default: true)

parameters.name: max_commits
parameters.description: Maximum number of Git commits to index as trajectory steps (default: 100)

parameters.name: attach_mode
parameters.description: Attachment mode: 'lens' (read-only ephemeral query), 'ingest' (extract KIs), or 'replay' (trajectory inspection). Default: 'lens'

entrypoints.name: brain_query
entrypoints.description: Query across one or all mounted external brains/repos for knowledge, code, solutions, or trajectories

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Natural language question or search prompt

parameters.name: brain_alias
parameters.description: Specific attached brain/repo alias to target (or all if omitted)

parameters.name: include_trajectories
parameters.description: Include past agent tool execution steps and git commit histories

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Number of top results to return (default: 5)

entrypoints.name: brain_list_attached
entrypoints.description: List all currently mounted external brains and repositories, their detected formats, and index statistics

entrypoints.name: brain_detach
entrypoints.description: Unmount a foreign brain or repository and release its memory indexes

parameters.name: brain_alias
parameters.description: Alias of the brain/repository to unmount
